visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Give the ordinary queue, each chosen material action, the first default notice, the junior-claim freeze, the superintendent's arrival, the final authority choice, and each aftermath family its own visual_scene_id.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base prompt restates the visible room geometry, materials, light, interfaces, bodies, equipment, and staging for a general image model. Modifiers add only explicit state or branch deltas.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: humane retro-industrial science-fiction storybook illustration, precise dark ink linework under translucent gouache, rust-orange work lamps and pale cyan interface light, tactile worn metal and polymer, readable silhouettes, restrained facial expression, dry workplace comedy under administrative dread, cinematic square composition.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble global_style_cue plus the scene base_image_prompt, then include visual refs only for named characters or groups declared visible in that frame, followed by triggered state_image_modifiers and global_branch_image_modifiers. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints.
